text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Durandal! Thank you for the birthday gift♪ 
I actually saw it on a trip once and had 
my eye on it ever since—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wait, about that... ...I wonder if I could 
take it back after all?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A shamrock-embroidered handkerchief, 
watching a King Arthur play... There are 
countless gifts worthy of you, and yet... 
I...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A dragon and sword keychain, of all 
things! I totally let my personal tastes 
run wild! So—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Sir Knight. I am humbled by your 
consideration. Indeed, the gift you chose 
has truly touched my heart."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A guardian dragon and a sword of justice. 
A masterful craft blending two great 
symbols. No wonder this design has 
captured so many hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You chose and presented this to me—your 
aesthetic eye is truly impeccable. ...You 
have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sir Durandal, thank you for the wonderful 
gift. I shall treasure it dearly♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Your Highness's gracious response 
to my thoughtless remark is more honor 
than I deserve."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Your Highness Fine. May 
countless blessings grace the path you 
tread!
